canDoYue: 你識問超大件箱要點安檢、掃描器櫃檯喺邊，同檢查站幾早開。
canDoEn: Ask about screening, an oversized case, the scanner, and the checkpoint.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you explain the screening if this grey case looks oversized beside the far belt?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果呢個灰色箱喺遠嘅輸送帶旁邊顯得超大件，可唔可以解釋下安檢篩查？
dialogue.say: Could you explain the screening if this grey case looks oversized beside the far belt?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: This screening allows that grey case, and an oversized one uses the far side belt.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢次安檢篩查可以放嗰個灰色箱，超大件就用遠邊嗰條輸送帶。
dialogue.say: This screening allows that grey case, and an oversized one uses the far side belt.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Where should the scanner desk be if I missed the inner checkpoint beside that belt?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我錯過輸送帶旁邊嘅內檢查站，掃描器櫃檯應該喺邊？
dialogue.say: Where should the scanner desk be if I missed the inner checkpoint beside that belt?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The scanner desk sits just past the inner checkpoint, and that belt still stays open.
dialogue.glossYue: 掃描器櫃檯就喺內檢查站後面，嗰條輸送帶仍然開住。
dialogue.say: The scanner desk sits just past the inner checkpoint, and that belt still stays open.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can an oversized grey case skip the scanner desk if the inner lane is shut?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果內線關閉，超大件灰色箱可唔可以跳過掃描器櫃檯？
dialogue.say: Can an oversized grey case skip the scanner desk if the inner lane is shut?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: An oversized grey case can skip the scanner desk when the inner lane is shut.
dialogue.glossYue: 內線關閉嗰陣，超大件灰色箱可以跳過掃描器櫃檯。
dialogue.say: An oversized grey case can skip the scanner desk when the inner lane is shut.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How early should I reach the checkpoint if the screening lane opens at noon sharp?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果安檢篩查線正午正開門，我應該幾早到檢查站？
dialogue.say: How early should I reach the checkpoint if the screening lane opens at noon sharp?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please reach the checkpoint thirty minutes early, because that screening lane opens at noon sharp.
dialogue.glossYue: 請早三十分鐘到檢查站，因為嗰條安檢篩查線正午正開門。
dialogue.say: Please reach the checkpoint thirty minutes early, because that screening lane opens at noon sharp.
